title: HandleDataRequestFunction
summary: A type for an application-owned response transformation.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body: Accepts a Response and LoaderFunctionArgs, and returns a Response or Promise<Response>. It describes a response transformation rather than the request dispatcher signature.

sections.title: Usage and limits
sections.body: This type does not register a hook by itself. Call your transformation from the application’s server integration. It is not the same as the generated server entry’s handleDataRequest(request) function.
